2608.16347.title: Architecture-Dependent Causal Transfer of Activation States Across Large Language Models
2608.16347.paper_summary: Direct communication between AI systems relies on natural language as an intermediate layer, incurring encoding/decoding overhead, token cost, and latency. We ask whether internal activation states can instead be transferred causally between different large language model (LLM) architectures via a learned projection, evaluated at three levels: representational similarity, cross-model retrieval from projected states, and end-to-end causal transfer via activation injection during generation. Using four architecturally diverse open-weight models (Qwen2-0.5B, Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B, FLAN-T5-base), we find that representational alignment in trained models exceeds a random-initialization null baseline and is best captured by a rank-based metric (mutual k-nearest-neighbour alignment), more robust to activation-magnitude outliers than centered kernel alignment (CKA) or Procrustes analysis. A learned projection network retrieves the correct target-model representation from a held-out set well above chance for the three causal decoder-only model pairs (45-50% top-1 accuracy vs. 5% chance) but at chance level for the encoder-based FLAN-T5. Injecting projected activations into a target model during generation produces a statistically significant, pre-registered causal effect on retrieval-based output similarity for only one of the three decoder-only pairs (Qwen2-0.5B to Phi-3-mini: 23.3% vs. 0.0% under negative control, p=0.047, FDR-corrected); the two pairs targeting Mistral-7B show no such effect despite comparable representational alignment at the hidden-state level. We interpret these results as evidence for causal transfer of the representational vehicle, not of meaning, and conclude that end-to-end activation-state transfer between LLMs, as currently implemented, is architecture-dependent rather than universal.
2608.16347.paper_summary_zh: 直接在AI系統之間的通信依賴於自然語言作為中介層，這會產生編碼/解碼的開銷、標記成本和延遲。我們詢問是否可以通過學習的投影在不同的大型語言模型（LLM）架構之間因果地轉移內部激活狀態，並在三個層面上進行評估：表示相似性、從投影狀態的跨模型檢索，以及在生成過程中通過激活注入的端到端因果轉移。使用四個架構多樣的開放權重模型（Qwen2-0.5B、Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B、FLAN-T5-base），我們發現訓練模型中的表示對齊超過隨機初始化的虛無基線，並且最適合用基於排名的度量（互相k最近鄰對齊）來捕捉，對於激活幅度異常值的穩健性超過了中心核對齊（CKA）或普克魯斯分析。學習的投影網絡從保留集檢索正確的目標模型表示，在三對因果解碼器模型中，準確率遠高於隨機（45-50% 的 top-1 準確率對比 5% 的隨機機率），但對於基於編碼器的 FLAN-T5 則達到隨機水平。在生成過程中將投影激活注入目標模型，對於三對解碼器模型中的僅有一對（Qwen2-0.5B 到 Phi-3-mini：23.3% 對比 0.0% 在負控制下，p=0.047，FDR 修正）產生了統計上顯著的、預註冊的因果效應，然而針對 Mistral-7B 的兩對模型儘管在隱藏狀態層面上具有相似的表示對齊，卻未顯示出此類效應。我們將這些結果解釋為表示載體的因果轉移的證據，而非意義的轉移，並得出結論，當前實施的 LLM 之間的端到端激活狀態轉移是依賴於架構的，而非普遍適用。
2608.16347.author: Fernando Cardenas Piepereit et.al.
